notes: Titles and DOIs verified in acquired texts. Replication is the authors’ accepted manuscript, with different pagination from the supplied published-paper locator. Study 1 replication maps to §3.2 and Table 2; its sample reporting is internally inconsistent (p. 8 n = 213 self-relevant; Table 7 N = 211; p. 13 t(421)). Therefore analytic n is null and target_match is unknown pending resolution; d and p are a paired printed Table 2 result. No n inferred from degrees of freedom. In the original cached PDF text, the equals sign is extracted as 5; quotations preserve this extraction artifact, and statistic values reflect the printed equation.
